limitations: Different attention architectures and parameter counts; common backbone and workload are matched.
Training at sequence length 2048 only; does not measure decoding or recurrent memory savings.
One fixed microbatch size, no batch-size optimization.
measurement_scope: Fresh reference initialization; actual packed-data single-GPU training loop; steady intervals include data transfer, accumulation, optimizer, numerical checks and ordinary logging. Compilation, evaluation and checkpointing excluded.
planned_acceptance: Repeat GDN signed-write and Mosaic query production-context output/gradient tests in the benchmark allocation; existing comprehensive qualifications cover these backends on B300.
